summary: Verified bug-fix PR for 2 production APK bugs. (1) Auth deep-link route: navigated directly to /auth with no session — confirmed it renders the new 'Signing you in…' spinner screen (NOT the old 'Unmatched Route' error), and correctly auto-redirects to /login within ~4s (matched expected grace-window behavior in auth.tsx). (2) Gate logic: _layout.tsx now treats segments[0]==='auth' same as 'login' for inAuth — confirmed no infinite loop / stuck screen. (3) AI Coach chat regression: seeded a fresh test user+session in Mongo (user_qa_test / qa-test-token-123), injected token into localStorage, sent a live message from the coach.tsx UI — got a real, non-empty Claude Sonnet 4.5 streamed response (855 chars) rendered into msg-assistant bubble; no empty bubble, no error. This confirms removing .env exclusion lines from /app/.gitignore did NOT break anything locally (backend still reads EMERGENT_LLM_KEY correctly in this preview env). (4) General regression: Home/Portfolio/Finance/Profile tabs all load correctly with seeded demo data (Business Health 87, 3 portfolio assets, financial charts, active goals) — no visual or data regressions. (5) Backend: ran full pytest suite (107 tests across 6 files including AI coach streaming, security fixes, PayPal, goals/asset/finance, connections/checkout) — 107/107 passed (100%).

_layout.tsx Gate fix (inAuth includes 'auth') is minimal and correctly scoped — does not alter the onboarding or tabs redirect branches.

.gitignore change (removing 3 .env exclusion lines) is a config-only change; confirmed no other env-related regressions were introduced in this preview (backend .env still loaded via load_dotenv without issue).
